EvidenceAssurance.scope: string, trimmed, <= 2000 characters; empty permitted only for unspecified
EvidenceAssurance.observationEnd: optional normalized ISO date/time; must be >= start

EvidenceProvenance.sourceDocumentIds: string[] immutable original source citation IDs
EvidenceProvenance.check: optional {resultId, connectorId, connectorKind, connectorName, checkId, observedAt, sourceConfigHash}

Evidence.supersedesId: string? immutable same-workspace explicit prior artifact

types.EvidenceReviewScope: existing fields + optional assurance, provenance, supersedesId, all bound by evidenceReviewScope helper
types.EvidenceReview: existing shape; decision adds withdrawn; note is required for rejected/withdrawn

EffectiveEvidenceState.status: valid | pending-review | rejected | withdrawn | expired | not-yet-valid | invalid | superseded
EffectiveEvidenceState.currentlyValid: boolean (valid even if superseded accepted artifact remains valid)

RequirementEvidenceLineage.items: Array<{ evidence: Evidence (metadata only), effective: EffectiveEvidenceState, unknowns: string[] }>

http.create: POST /api/workspaces/:ws/evidence and files metadata accept assurance?: EvidenceAssurance and supersedesId?: string; server rejects automated-check upload kind
http.update: PATCH /api/workspaces/:ws/evidence/:id accepts assurance?: EvidenceAssurance and optional expectedScope guard from inspected evidence; supersedesId/provenance remain immutable
http.review: same PATCH {decision: accepted | rejected | withdrawn, note?: string, expectedScope: evidenceReviewScope(inspectedEvidence), expectedReviewId: string | null}; rejected/withdrawn note required; work.approve capability. Send last viewed reviewHistory ID or null. HTTP omission safely defaults to null (only first-ever review); service rejects if stored latest review differs.

core_helpers: effectiveEvidenceState(evidence, allEvidence, at?, requirementId?); compatibleEvidenceSeries(previous,next); evidenceReviewScope; isEvidenceValid remain exported
semantics: Missing provenance remains not recorded, never inferred from current links.
Explicit replacement must match assurance kind/scope and source category; observation period may advance.
Only accepted currently valid successor linked to selected requirement suppresses expired predecessor risk.
Automatic series matches immutable check source configuration identity or policy ID; agent narrative cannot claim automated-check or attestation.
Lineage at= evaluates current recorded metadata at that instant; it is not a reconstructed historical revision.
Supersession only activates at or after the successor matching accepted review time.
Recorded approved-policy content/data/collection are immutable; approve a new policy version for a new artifact.
Review identity is a separate optimistic precondition, never included in the artifact scope or hash.
Validity and freshness begin no earlier than the latest current accepted review time; renewal coverage begins at max(collection, acceptance). Earlier review decisions are not reconstructed.
